psychological_meaning: Luxor Gold evokes feelings of wealth, sophistication, and timeless elegance. It symbolizes prosperity, abundance, and high quality. This color connects to tradition and history, suggesting wisdom and knowledge gained over time. It can also represent stability, reliability, and refined taste.

real_world_examples.title: Pharaoh's Mask
real_world_examples.description: The golden mask of Tutankhamun is a prime example of the timeless appeal and regal association of this color.

real_world_examples.title: Luxury Watch
real_world_examples.description: High-end watches often utilize gold plating to convey status and sophistication.
